Doink's ring attire is circa 1993 according to the good folks at Mattel headquarters.
This figure's head scan is based on Matt Osborne during his run as Doink The Clown. He has his evil smile.
Doink The Clown's figure comes with a unique opportunity to change his hair to your choosing as the figure comes with three different hairpieces.
The only flaw I can really find is that he does not have his signature entrance jacket.
